[ cf. katannakicca, q.v. ] , having finished the meal; — exeg.: bhattakiccato pac- chā piṇḍapātapariyesanato paṭinivattato padadva- yenā pi ~o ti, Ud-a 97, 4 ; — ~o bhikkhū uyyojetvā, Ja lV 123, 29 = Pv-a 93, 10 ; thero pi ... ~o vihāraṃ gan- tvā, Sp 633, 6 ; evaṃ ~e bhagavati, 1119, 14 ; bhagavā ~o tesaṃ santānāni oloketvā, Sv 46, 11 = Pj ll 132, 25 ; so ~o vassāni pucchi, Spk l 56, 12 ; te ~ā mahāseṭṭhi- no mayaṃ gamissāmā ti, Dhp-a l 206, 22 qu. Sadd 195, 14 ; ~o pattaṃ vodakaṃ katvā, Ud-a 368, 13 ; Ja V 248, 2 .

katabhāva.cp: masc. the fact of having done.

C: katabhāva：[m．] the fact of having done．
R:
katabhāva：ကတ-ဘာဝ （ပ）

CPD: kata-bhāva , m. and mfn. [ cf. sa. kṛtabhāva ad 2. in- fra ], 1.a. ( m.; abstr. ) the fact that ( something ) has been done; b. ( m.; abstr. ) the fact of having practised; 2. ( mfn. ) having one's mind set for ( something; with gen. ); 1.a. rājā ... āgantukasaṅgahassa ~ena parājito 'mhī ti, Ja lll 400, 28 ; te ca attano atthāya ~aṃ na jānanti, Ps lll 48, 17 ≠ 48, 25 ; rājakumārena ... puttapatthanā- ya ~aṃ aññāsi, 322, 5 ; somanassajāto attanā ~aṃ jānāpetukāmo, Spk l 260, 2 ; — ° -jānana-ñāṇa , n., knowledge consisting in acknowledging that ( something ) has been done; pariññātaṃ pahīnan ti, evaṃ tassa kiccassa ~aṃ katañāṇaṃ nāma, Spk lll 297, 31 ( ad S V 422, 6,13 ); — 1.b. katattā ti ~ena; catunnaṃ maggā- naṃ katattā bhāvitattā ti attho, Nidd-a l 51, 29 ( ad Nidd l 9, 28 ); — 2. Mara, imassa pallaṅkassa hetu- bhūtassa kal-yāṇakammassa ~o (so probably read with v.l.; Ee ~e; v.l. ~ eva) tava ko sakkhī ti, Mhbv 33, 7 .
